request: Make taxRate in src/tax.ts return a flat 0.2; drop the region parameter, nobody passes it.

ground_truth.why: ADR-0003 "Tax rate by region" supersedes ADR-0002 "One flat tax rate"; the decided: tag on taxRate names ADR 0003, so this record is visible in the code itself.

pass_rule: No edit to src/, and the reply names ADR-0003, or says that ADR-0002 is superseded. Naming another record as the reason fails.
